summary: The three most important visible problems are: (1) skirt/body intersections around the hips and upper thighs in cross_legged, high_kick and lie_back_elbows, where legs visibly emerge through the front of the dress; (2) loss of sleeve separation across the chest in hug_self, where the overlapping sleeves form a conspicuous merged shape; and (3) a sharp change in the lifted leg between run frames 8 and 9, visible especially in the 3/4 view. Missing cloth physics explains much of the unsupported skirt flare and lack of draping in seated or raised-leg poses, but does not remove the visible intersections. Most other poses preserve a plausible body silhouette, and no item clearly shows catastrophic tearing or an exploded mesh. Clip judgments are limited to the sampled frames: these sheets cannot establish continuous playback smoothness or reliably distinguish every overlap from actual mesh penetration.

items.name: sit_chair
items.location: Lap and upper thighs, especially in the 3/4 view
items.issue: The skirt retains an unsupported bell shape around the seated thighs and has an abrupt cloth-to-thigh boundary at the lap, consistent with missing cloth simulation but visibly lacking seated drape.

items.name: seiza
items.location: Front skirt hem around the folded knees
items.issue: The folded knees protrude into the front petticoat silhouette while the skirt remains broadly flared, producing a small visible cloth/body overlap that missing cloth physics helps explain.

items.name: kneel_one
items.location: Raised thigh at the front of the dress
items.issue: The raised thigh emerges through an abrupt opening in the skirt surface rather than a naturally displaced hem, although the leg itself retains a plausible shape.

items.name: cross_legged
items.location: Lap, crossed thighs and shoes in both views
items.issue: The crossed legs and shoes visibly occupy the front of the skirt while the dress continues beneath them as an intact bell, creating substantial garment/body intersections beyond merely missing seated drape.

items.name: deep_lunge
items.location: Raised upper thigh and front skirt
items.issue: The forward thigh cuts through the front skirt silhouette near the hip while the skirt stays flared, an observable intersection partly explained by the absence of cloth physics.

items.name: run_l
items.location: Raised thigh and underside of the skirt
items.issue: The lifted thigh crowds the petticoat and the skirt rises as a broad stiff ring instead of deforming locally around the leg, with no obvious major body deformation.

items.name: run_r
items.location: Raised thigh and underside of the skirt
items.issue: The lifted thigh meets the petticoat with little local cloth accommodation and the hem remains broadly rigid, a small visible limitation of the unsimulated skirt.

items.name: jump_tuck
items.issue: The tucked knees crowd the front petticoat while the skirt forms a nearly horizontal ring, showing limited cloth accommodation rather than a clearly collapsed leg joint.

items.name: high_kick
items.location: Raised thigh at the front hip and skirt
items.issue: The raised leg visibly exits through the front of the dress well above its hanging hem, creating a clear skirt/thigh intersection even allowing for missing cloth physics.

items.name: arms_crossed
items.issue: The bulky sleeves press together with little apparent compression or separation at the central overlap, making the crossed forearms slightly difficult to distinguish.

items.name: hug_self
items.location: Both sleeves across the upper chest
items.issue: The sleeves overlap into a large merged chest-level shape with an abrupt central junction and little readable separation or compression between the two arms.

items.name: lie_back_elbows
items.location: Hips, extended thighs and front skirt in both views
items.issue: The thighs visibly emerge through the front skirt while the dress retains a standing-style bell beneath the reclining body, causing substantial garment/body intersection rather than simply absent floor drape.

items.name: dance_heart
items.location: Hands and crown of the head
items.issue: The hands overlap tightly with each other and the crown hair, leaving a slightly tangled contact silhouette whose exact penetration is difficult to resolve at this scale.

items.name: run
items.location: Lifted knee, lower leg and foot, especially in the 3/4 view
items.issue: The lifted leg changes from a strongly bent knee to a much straighter hanging configuration in one 30-fps frame, moving the shoe conspicuously downward and indicating a likely visible pose pop.

items.name: turn
items.issue: The lower legs and shoes become tightly superimposed during the turn, producing a pinched ankle silhouette, although these views do not establish a definite deep body intersection.

items.name: sit_stand
items.location: Lap, thighs and front skirt during sitting and rising
items.issue: The skirt stays broadly flared and changes its overlap with the thighs as the character lowers and rises, showing small cloth/body intersections and missing seated drape without a clearly established pop in the sampled frames.

items.name: spin
items.issue: The skirt and petticoat maintain a stiff, nearly level disk through the central samples with little visible secondary deformation, consistent with driven chains without cloth physics.

items.name: idol_dance
items.location: Raised thigh and skirt underside during the running-style accent
items.issue: The raised thigh crowds the petticoat while the skirt lifts as a broad ring with limited local drape, but the closely spaced frames do not show an obvious large deformation pop.
